answer: A newcomer earns the right to submit only after an island trial: three short tasks drawn from a beacon pool, each unique to that applicant and due within a day, so answers cannot be copied. A reviewer checks each trial within 48 hours against a marble rubric for original reasoning; a copied trial or duplicate device fingerprint discards the application and blocks that device for a cycle. One honest newcomer spends three hours once, while a thousand fakes need three thousand distinct trials.
